Every referenced project theorem and definition, plus explicit theorem families, is directly captured; module families retain their proved aggregate interfaces. Each ordinary symbolic reference has one resolved target; ambiguous intended names are namespace-qualified. Generated projections are not silently inferred from unrelated short names.
